# apple_app_event (Resource)

Defines an in-app event: a timely event in an app, such as a competition or a premiere, that the App Store shows as an event card and details page. Add its text with `apple_app_event_localization` and its images or videos with `apple_app_asset_library_placement` on a localization, then submit it with the `apple_submit_app_event` action. An app can have 50 draft events. An optional argument removed from the configuration keeps its value. Destroying the resource deletes the event with its localizations. Import it with `<app_id>/<id>`; `data.apple_app_events` lists an app's events.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_app_event" "summer" {
  app_id               = data.apple_app.example.id
  reference_name       = "Summer Cup"
  badge                = "COMPETITION"
  deep_link            = "https://example.com/events/summer"
  purchase_requirement = "NO_COST_ASSOCIATED"
  primary_locale       = "en-US"
  priority             = "HIGH"
  purpose              = "ATTRACT_NEW_USERS"

  territory_schedules = [{
    territories   = ["USA", "CAN"]
    publish_start = "2027-06-01T16:00:00Z"
    event_start   = "2027-06-15T16:00:00Z"
    event_end     = "2027-06-30T16:00:00Z"
  }]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.
- `reference_name` (String) Reference name of the event, shown only in App Store Connect.

### Optional

- `badge` (String) Badge shown above the event's name: `LIVE_EVENT`, `PREMIERE`, `CHALLENGE`, `COMPETITION`, `NEW_SEASON`, `MAJOR_UPDATE`, `SPECIAL_EVENT`.
- `deep_link` (String) Link that opens the event in the app, e.g. `https://example.com/events/summer`.
- `primary_locale` (String) Locale the App Store falls back to, e.g. `en-US`. The event needs an `apple_app_event_localization` for it.
- `priority` (String) Priority among the app's events: `HIGH`, `NORMAL`.
- `purchase_requirement` (String) Whether taking part needs an in-app purchase or a subscription, e.g. `NO_COST_ASSOCIATED`. The API doesn't list the values it accepts.
- `purpose` (String) Audience of the event: `APPROPRIATE_FOR_ALL_USERS`, `ATTRACT_NEW_USERS`, `KEEP_ACTIVE_USERS_INFORMED`, `BRING_BACK_LAPSED_USERS`.
- `territory_schedules` (Attributes List) When the event is published and takes place, per group of territories. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--territory_schedules))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the in-app event.
- `state` (String) State of the event: `DRAFT`, `READY_FOR_REVIEW`, `WAITING_FOR_REVIEW`, `IN_REVIEW`, `REJECTED`, `ACCEPTED`, `APPROVED`, `PUBLISHED`, `PAST`, `ARCHIVED`.

<a id="nestedatt--territory_schedules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `territory_schedules`

Required:

- `event_end` (String) When the event ends, in UTC.
- `event_start` (String) When the event starts, in UTC.
- `publish_start` (String) When the event appears on the App Store, in UTC, e.g. `2026-12-01T16:00:00Z`.
- `territories` (Set of String) Territories the schedule applies to, e.g. `["USA", "CAN"]`; see `data.apple_territories`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_app_event.summer
  identity = {
    app_id = "6446452616"
    id     = "6449876543"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the in-app event.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <app_id>/<id>
terraform import apple_app_event.summer 6446452616/6449876543
```
